categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Jove Enterprise Limited primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs), including single-sided, double-sided, and multi-layer boards. Their products cover high-frequency high-speed boards, metal substrates, rigid-flex boards, advanced HDI boards, embedded component boards, and packaging substrates, serving industries such as telecommunications, industrial control, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, semiconductor packaging, and medical electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnection (HDI), thick copper boards, 5G antenna boards, high-frequency high-speed boards, rigid-flex combination boards, embedded components, and PSIP technology. Production is mainly conducted through self-owned production lines with a 'make-to-order' model, supplemented by outsourced processing for non-core processes like drilling and surface treatment. They have implemented digital management systems such as PCS traceability and MES for quality control and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading telecommunications equipment providers and companies in industrial control, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, semiconductor packaging, and medical electronics sectors. Notable clients are Vertiv, NCAB, AE, Asteelflash, Lacroix, Lenze, Schneider, Delta, Flex Power, Jabil, BYD, AAC Technologies, GoerTek, and Luxshare. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products exported to Europe, Asia, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen (Shajing, Songgang), Heshan, and an overseas production facility in Thailand (Rayong). It has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Thailand, supporting its global market expansion. The Thailand factory is positioned to serve overseas customers and support international market growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Jove Enterprise Limited operates mainly in the midstream of the PCB supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying customized printed circuit boards to downstream electronic product manufacturers. It procures raw materials such as copper clad laminates, semi-cured sheets, copper foil, and other materials from upstream suppliers and delivers finished PCB products directly to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-layer count PCBs, high-density interconnection, rigid-flex boards, high-frequency high-speed boards, embedded components, and PSIP technologies. It invests heavily in innovation to develop new products such as AI power modules, embedded inductors, and advanced packaging substrates. The company also focuses on intelligent manufacturing, digital transformation, and expanding overseas production capabilities, particularly through its Thailand facility.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized printed circuit board products to industrial customers. The company uses a direct sales model with most contracts signed directly with downstream customers, supplemented by limited trade sales. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance, with some sales conducted under VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and ranks 47th among Chinese comprehensive PCB companies according to CPCA. It competes in a fragmented global PCB market with many manufacturers, including industry leaders with larger scale and market share. Shenzhen Jove Enterprise Limited differentiates itself through technology innovation, product quality, diversified product offerings, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.45 billion, a 17.15% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.1 million, up 45.01%. Total assets reached RMB 2.99 billion, growing 32% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth driven by expanding markets in new energy vehicles, data centers, and semiconductor packaging, with increased R&D investment accounting for 5.27% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, customization, and advanced technology in its PCB products to meet stringent customer requirements in critical applications such as automotive electronics and telecommunications. Its multi-base production layout enables flexible volume production and diverse product offerings. The integration of digital manufacturing and quality traceability systems ensures superior product quality and delivery performance, fostering long-term partnerships with leading global customers.
